content.description: Lot of short sleeve tops with a crew-style neckline, shown in white and navy. Both garments photographed laid flat show brown marks on the front body: the white top has several brown marks across the chest and middle, and the navy top has brown marks on the front left and centre. One photograph shows folded items in white and navy stacked together; their condition cannot be assessed from that view. No tags, labels, size markings or care labels are visible. Fibre content and sizes are not shown in the photographs.
content.title: Short sleeve tops, white and navy, visible marks
